name: Lee Sin Old Voice mod
creator: polten
description:
Pretty straightforward, I replaced every new voice-line with the old one. I got the files from this reddit thread: https://www.reddit.com/r/LeeSinMains/comments/cf5utf/guide_how_to_get_old_lee_voice_back/

The original author has of the post was deleted unfortunately, and it`s what made me do this mod. Originally the author mentions that you would just replace the LeeSin.en_US.wad.client file in the original directory but that doesn`t work anymore (presuming it ever worked). Tried to find someone who had done this mod but there was none. I just did it myself lol.

Note: I took the liberty to add more voice-lines in case of some events (that were not available before the VGU). For example: when you score a PENTAKILL Lee Sin will say "Your will my hands", or when you recall Lee will say "Find your center".
